elements.label: Jira and GitHub app icon tiles (sequential grey flash)

pattern.description: Inside a static connector-logo tray, individual app tiles flash to a darkened grey state for one or two frames, one tile at a time (Jira, then GitHub), then snap back to white.
pattern.why_premium: The flashes land on music transients in the stem, so a static logo row gets a rhythmic pulse without any layout movement, keeping the tray readable while signalling each integration in turn.

build_hint.gsap: Static tray; for each tile in order, a timeline `.set(tile, {filter: 'brightness(0.55) saturate(0)'})` at the beat time followed by `.set(tile, {filter: 'none'}, '+=0.067')` (step, no tween). Place tiles on beat timestamps rather than a fixed stagger.
build_hint.remotion: Per tile, compute `const on = frame >= beatFrame && frame < beatFrame + 2;` and apply `filter: on ? 'brightness(0.55) grayscale(1)' : 'none'` with no interpolation; beatFrame comes from the music beat list per tile.

notes: b01 is a union box covering both the Jira and GitHub tiles, which flash at different frames (f110 Jira, f120 GitHub); recorded as one element to avoid inventing a box. Flashes last one to two frames and could also be an encode artefact or a hard-cut tease. Filmstrip timestamps (0:03.604 at f108) differ from facts start_s 3.904 by 0.3 s.
